{{Top|leg}}
'''Conner webs''' were a modified and updated version of the [[conner net]]. Conner webs were not restricted for use against ground targets, and could be deployed in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The web enveloped a target, such as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], delivering an electromagnetic charge and ionizing the target.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
